_comment: Family Priority Mode. Each member role raises the importance of the rooms that matter most to that person. 'focus' areas do the same for a household goal. Multipliers change only the personalised 'family view' score and the order of advice; the official score is never changed.

elderly.label: Elderly parents
elderly.note: Their bedroom and nearby toilet matter most; avoid remedies that add steps or clutter to their route.

children.label: Young children
children.note: Keep their bedroom calm and the play area in the living room uncluttered.

students.label: Students
students.note: Study placement and desk direction matter most.

work_from_home.label: Working from home
work_from_home.note: The work corner and its direction matter most.

couple.label: Couple
couple.note: The master bedroom is the priority room.

home_cook.label: Cooks daily
home_cook.note: Kitchen placement and the cooking range position matter most.

devotional.label: Daily worship
devotional.note: The pooja room and its facing direction matter most.
